description.en: A single-row deep-groove ball bearing, 8 mm bore × 22 mm outside diameter × 7 mm wide. Its outer ring seats in a housing bore; an 8 mm shaft or an M8 bolt passes through its inner ring.
description.es: Un rodamiento rígido de bolas de una hilera, de 8 mm de barreno × 22 mm de diámetro exterior × 7 mm de ancho. Su anillo exterior asienta en un alojamiento; por su anillo interior pasa una flecha de 8 mm o un tornillo M8.
description.fr: Un roulement rigide à une rangée de billes, alésage 8 mm × diamètre extérieur 22 mm × largeur 7 mm. Sa bague extérieure se loge dans un alésage de logement ; un arbre de 8 mm ou une vis M8 traverse sa bague intérieure.
description.pt: Um rolamento rígido de uma carreira de esferas, furo de 8 mm × diâmetro exterior de 22 mm × 7 mm de largura. O anel exterior assenta num alojamento; um eixo de 8 mm ou um parafuso M8 passa pelo anel interior.

sources.title: SKF 608 deep groove ball bearing (distributor listing)

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of side face A, on the bearing axis. +z runs along the axis through the bearing to side face B at z = 7. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the bearing is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry.

interfaces.note: Male: the bearing goes into its housing bore. The normal runs from face A through the bearing toward face B, the side the housing lies on, so a seat framed at its entrance (normal out of the cavity) takes the bearing face B first: face B lands on the seat floor and face A flush with the entrance. (Corrected in ASM-1 v1.1: the normal was −z, which placed the bearing outside the seat.)
Female: the bore receives the axle. The axle's shoulder or spacer bears on face B.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The catalog key equals the interface-sizes key bearing-608, which describes the same part's outer fit.
